preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have token balance (xenoX tokens) in its address

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the transferTokens() function to transfer tokens from the contract's balance to the attacker's address. First ensure the contract has accumulated tokens from fees (tax, liquidity, dev fees). The function requires only owner privilege and transfers any amount up to the contract's token balance to any recipient.
